hypotheses.justification: `hx` only matters for elements of the left-hand set, and every such element already gives it. By the definition `E4Set X = {p | (p.1 : ℝ) > X ^ (1/11) ∧ 1 ≤ |p.2^2 - 5*p.1^22| ∧ |…| ≤ 4*X}`, the membership `hu : (x, u) ∈ E4Set X` (introduced by `intro u hu`) contains `hu.1 : (x : ℝ) > X ^ (1/11)` up to defeq. So the proof works unchanged once `hx` is replaced by `hu.1` inside the `intro`: `five_x22_sub_4X_pos X hX x hu.1` and `u_ne_zero_of_fiber X hX x hu.1 …`. The conclusion does not mention `hx`.

The proof uses `hX` only to show `u ≠ 0`, through `5*x^22 - 4*X > 0`, and that holds for every real X once `hu` is assumed. The interval bounds come from `|u^2 - 5x^22| ≤ 4X` (lemma `u_sq_in_interval`, which has no hypothesis on X). Case X < 0: then 4X < 0 ≤ |…|, so the fiber is empty and the inclusion is vacuous. Case 0 ≤ X ≤ 1: since x ≥ 1, 5x^22 ≥ 5 > 4 ≥ 4X. Case X > 1: the library lemma `x11_gt_X_of_x_gt` (needs only `1 < X` and `hx`, or `hu.1`) gives x^11 > X. Since x ≥ 1, x^22 ≥ x^11 > X, so 5x^22 > 4X. In every case 5x^22 - 4X > 0. Then u = 0 would give 0 ≥ 5x^22 - 4X > 0, a contradiction, which is the same `nlinarith` step as in `u_ne_zero_of_fiber`. The case split on the sign of u then goes through as before. This works whether or not `hx` is kept, because `hu.1` supplies it, so `hX` and `hx` can each be deleted, and also both together.
